content: Fuzzy title matching: false positives = unrelated items merged; false negatives = real matches missed due to strict thresholds/messy data. Normalize (lowercase, strip punctuation, expand abbreviations) before matching. Use ~85% similarity for auto-merge candidates; use higher threshold (90-95%) when auto-merging (costly mistake) vs lower (70-84%) when human review exists. Weighted/IDF-token matching improves over naive fuzzy string distance for product titles.
